title: Caps Lock assignment to Alt+Shift cannot be be remapped

status.label: Alt+Shift alone is not a valid shortcut target
status.detail: Current Keyboard Manager requires a shortcut target to include an action key as well as a modifier. Alt+Shift contains only modifiers, so the configuration is rejected before it can be saved.

judgment.rationale: The only requested mapping is Caps Lock to Alt+Shift, which contains no action key. Current EditorHelpers::IsValidShortcut explicitly defines a valid shortcut as having at least one modifier and an action key, and returns false when actionKey is null. The validation dialog therefore reflects an unsupported modifier-only target; the report does not identify a separate defect with saving a valid mapping.
evidence: The issue lists PowerToys 0.97.2 and asks to map Caps Lock to Alt+Shift alone.
The reporter says the validation dialog appears and neither choice saves a mapping.
Current EditorHelpers::IsValidShortcut requires an action key in addition to at least one modifier; the Alt+Shift target has no action key.
judgment.recommended_action: Use a target shortcut that includes an action key; if saving a valid target still closes the editor without saving, file a separate issue with that exact reproduction.

fix_assessment.rationale: The requested Alt+Shift target is modifier-only and current Keyboard Manager validation requires an action key. Supporting a modifier-only target would be a feature/design change, not a bug fix for the reported behavior.

issue_context.summary: The reporter expects Caps Lock to emit the modifier-only combination Alt+Shift, but Keyboard Manager rejects the row during validation.
known_information: The issue lists PowerToys 0.97.2 on Windows 11 Pro.
The only requested mapping is Caps Lock to Alt+Shift, with no action key.
Current EditorHelpers::IsValidShortcut requires an action key and at least one modifier for a valid shortcut.
inferences: The dialog closes without saving because the only row is invalid and there is no valid mapping to persist; the report does not show a separate failure when a valid target is entered.
issue_context.analysis: The report's target consists only of Alt and Shift modifiers. Current Keyboard Manager explicitly rejects shortcuts without an action key, so the validation warning is expected and no code fix applies to the submitted configuration. If the dialog also loses valid rows, that separate behavior needs a new reproducible example.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and confirmed the requested target is Alt+Shift with no action key and there are no comments.
Read current EditorHelpers::IsValidShortcut; its documented invariant requires both a modifier and an action key.
Confirmed no separate valid mapping or current-build save failure is reported.
